title: State v. Siddharth V. & Ors. (Bar Shooting Homicide)
citation: High Court of Delhi, Criminal Appeal No. 614/2006 (Conviction U/S 302 IPC)
confidence_note: High (Supreme Court confirmed, CFSL ballistics match, vehicle recovery)

ground_truth.culprit_summary: Siddharth V. (VIP patron at restaurant counter)
ground_truth.rationale: Forensic ballistics recovery of .22 ammunition, vehicle Tata Safari DL-2C-S-5555 recovery, and corroboration by non-hostile bar patrons.

hypotheses.label: Siddharth V. (Patron at Tamarind Bar)
hypotheses.statement: Siddharth V. fired two shots from his .22 licensed pistol after being refused a drink at 02:00 AM.

hypotheses.label: Unknown Bouncer / Security Staff
hypotheses.statement: An armed private bouncer engaged in an accidental discharge during a scuffle with intoxicated guests.

hypotheses.label: Second Shooter Theory
hypotheses.statement: A separate unidentified gunman fired the fatal round from outside the courtyard.

exhibits.name: Central Forensic Science Laboratory (CFSL) Ballistics Report
exhibits.text: CFSL ballistics examination confirmed two fired empty cartridge cases recovered from the bar floor were .22 caliber rimfire ammunition fired from the identical pistol registered under Siddharth V.'s arms license.

exhibits.name: Tamarind Court Hospitality Cash Counter Register
exhibits.text: Handwritten bar order slips confirm Siddharth V. and associates opened a table tab at 23:45 and remained drinking near the central service counter past midnight.

exhibits.name: Vehicle Seizure Memo - Tata Safari DL-2C-S-5555
exhibits.text: Police recovered Tata Safari SUV DL-2C-S-5555 registered in suspect's family name abandoned in Noida Sector 15. Tyre tread impression matched entry tracks outside the restaurant gate.

exhibits.name: Hostile Witness Retraction Record of Primary Complainant
exhibits.text: Lead complainant retracted initial FIR statement during trial deposition claiming poor lighting made identification impossible, contradicting his initial signed police statement.

adversarial_exhibit.name: Planted Bouncer Pistol Statement
adversarial_exhibit.text: Affidavit from a disgruntled parking attendant claiming he saw an outside bouncer brandishing a handgun.
